# Shared-cache pages that no scan can discover, exported on top of the two
# derived sets (profile pointers, vendored-image pointers).
#
# Signing failed at 0x1880de740, reached from 0x180889c28. The page holding
# the target is in neither derived set because AMS computes it out of an
# obfuscated table at run time, so only a window around the observed fault
# can cover it. Regenerate the blob from .github/workflows/regenerate-store-profile.yml
# after editing this file; cmd/export-cache-pages -check says whether the
# committed blob actually contains every address listed here.
#
# Window 0x187e00000-0x188114000, 788 pages. It started as 4 MB around the
# fault and the 2026-10-28 regeneration reported how much of that exists: the
# first 788 pages resolve and the 236 above 0x188114000 do not, so the cache
# has nothing there and the window ends at the last page that does. Listing
# the absent ones would only make the check unable to stay strict.
#
# Window 0x1e7f00000-0x1e8000000, 1 MB. The signer, once 0x1880de740 was
# reachable, turned out to be an authenticated stub:/n#   adrp x17, 0x1e7ff5000; add x17, x17, #0x5e0; ldr x16, [x17]; braa x16, x17
# so what it actually needs is the slot page 0x1e7ff5000, which the blob has
# no pages near at all: the nearest below is 0x1e79a7000, above 0x1e800c000.
#
# Window 0x180675000-0x1806fa000, 134 pages: one whole image, not a guess.
#
# The signer now reaches 0x1806b44f0 and faults on fetch there, with the page
# reported as "neither profile nor cache". That address is 0x3f4f0 into the
# image whose Mach-O header sits at 0x180675000 -- the page dump of that
# address begins cffaedfe. The blob already carries 41 scattered pages of the
# image and none of the 93 between them, so the extent below is the image
# itself: first page that has a header, last page the blob holds.
